title: Strategic Human Rights Litigation: Desegregation and Damages

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Strategic human rights litigation (*stratégiai pereskedés*) uses court cases to dismantle systemic discrimination. In the landmark *Gyöngyöspata* lawsuit, civil rights lawyers proved that Roma children were segregated into substandard classrooms.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: In 2020, the Hungarian Supreme Court (*Kúria*) affirmed the award of substantial non-material damages (*sérelemdíj*), establishing that educational segregation causes irreparable harm to dignity and future life chances.
